eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 7:41 PM on JUL 24, 2026 Effective until 7:41 PM JUL 25, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: An immediate threat to life. This is a lawful order to leave now. The area is lawfully closed to public access. REASON	Evacuation ORDER in place for an active wildfire. Evacuate the area immediately. Evacuation Centers: Bishop Senior Center, 682 Spruce Street, Bishop, CA 93514. Those with large animals please take to the Tri-County Fair Ground, use the Mule Days Office Entrance, 1141 North Main Street, Bishop, CA 93514Follow: https://ready.inyocounty.us/ for updates
